selector.rationale: Initial biopsy showed features of invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, and treatment with cemiplimab led to partial metabolic response in the original lesion

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Although dermoscopic evaluation of papules revealed features typical of basal cell carcinoma, the initial biopsy and primary treatment response support invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma as the primary diagnosis
